title: Ad spend: is it reaching the right people
summary: The platform's own short qualifier, gate only and unscored. Five questions, every answer either passes or routes to a named exit, and passing starts the trial. Not-yet people land on the waitlist, wrong-fit people on one of three named exits.

body.title: Is your ad spend reaching the right people?
body.eyebrow: IF YOU RUN ADS FOR LEADS

questions.text: Are you running paid ads for leads right now?

options.label: Yes, on Google or another platform

questions.text: What is your monthly ad spend?

options.label: I run them for my own business
My team or an in-house marketer
I am an agency or freelancer running them for clients
I am learning, not running any yet

questions.text: What does a new client pay you?

options.label: Under ₹5,000, or I sell products online
Too many leads who are not a fit
Leads do not pick up or do not show up

disqualifiedContent.heading: This isn't built for you, and that's the point.
disqualifiedContent.subtext: Assess360 exists to stop businesses paying Meta to talk to the wrong people.
disqualifiedContent.bodyHtml: That screen you just hit fired a signal telling Meta not to show you this ad again. No lead stored, nothing in anyone's CRM, no follow-up. That is the product you just used.

exits.heading: This isn't built for you yet.
exits.subtext: It is built for people already paying for leads.
exits.bodyHtml: Once you are running ads for a business, this is the same door. That screen you just hit fired a signal telling Meta not to show you this ad again. No lead stored, no follow-up. That is the product you just used.

exits.name: Low ticket
exits.heading: This isn't built for your kind of sale.
exits.subtext: It pays off where every sales call is worth a lot.
exits.bodyHtml: Filtering leads before a call matters when a client is worth more than a call costs. At a low ticket or with products sold online, a checkout does that job better. That screen you just hit fired a signal telling Meta not to show you this ad again. That is the product you just used.

exits.name: Waitlisted
exits.heading: Not a no. A not yet.
exits.subtext: The fit is there. The timing is the one thing nobody can fix from this end.
exits.bodyHtml:
You keep your place, and we have your details, so this is a list with you actually on it. You are not going on any exclusion list either. When the piece that is missing today is in place, it is the same door.

If you want to look around in the meantime, the trial is open and nothing about it depends on this answer.
